title: D2607002 Executive Order of Dismissal
text:
ALJ/RMD/vhj Date of Issuance 7/1/2026
Decision 26-07-002
BEFORE THE PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA
National Community Renaissance, A
California nonprofit public benefit
corporation,
Complainant,
vs. Case 25-09-011
Southern California Edison Company
(U338E), and San Diego Gas & Electric
Company (U902E),
Defendants.
ORDER OF DISMISSAL
Upon written and unopposed request of all parties, Case 25-09-011 is
dismissed under Public Utilities Code Section 308(b) and Rule 4.5 of the
Commission’s Rules of Practice and Procedure, effective today.
Case 25-09-011 is closed.
Dated July 1, 2026, at San Francisco, California.
/s/ LEUWAM TESFAI
